scope: Actual GLB/header/accessor/image/import inspection; no import/render/Blender export or visual-cause attribution

finish_map.color_space: linear scalar roughness; albedo sRGB; normal linear tangent-space data

sourcePoseUnits.method: Authoring-only native bone-weighted full/half poses with smooth medial gain blend baked to small morphs; all original bones restored before export.

reconstruction_limits.original_modeling_history: Original rama-authored.blend absent; reconstructed production scene preserves imported merged geometry/actions and textures, not original modifiers/pieces/history.
reconstruction_limits.face_editable: Prefer pinned native rama-hero-face.blend for native face authoring; full re-export is a new candidate requiring rig/skin/animation/seam equivalence review.
reconstruction_limits.inspected_blends: Byte identities and retained source manifests only; no new Blender opening claimed.

permissions_and_routes: R2-01: separate scratch skin-only override or import-options candidate, one variable per candidate; preserve accepted map hashes and record values/intent.

R2-08: fresh candidate only, bounded displacement mask on existing face/body-skin/lip principal forms; preserve topology, UV, weights, skeleton, ordered morph identities, unrelated bytes and exact shared boundary.
Morph array byte preservation alone does not prove unchanged closure after a base-form edit; run seam/aperture and continuous blink tests.

Do not copy complete mid/far scenes into runtime: binding admits body/bow only, uses the single existing skeleton and excludes candidate RamaFace/animators. Body cheek/lip edits require rebuilt or explicitly near-only LOD policy.
No optimization, Rigify regeneration, REA bridge rerun, new repositories or Reddit retry needed for the current source question.

runtime_ownership.skeleton: RamaMotion sole existing pose owner; 164 bones; 9 embedded clips and separate 23-state library
runtime_ownership.face: RamaFacialPerformance binds exactly one morph mesh <=8000 vertices with ownership metadata; it changes four blink weights and never writes skeleton/eye transforms.
runtime_ownership.states: paused freezes; alive false closes lids over 0.28s; reset/teleported clears; effort max closure 0.14; full blink uses full+half arc interpolation. No authored jaw/lips/gaze/brow expressions.
runtime_ownership.binding_order: motion -> LOD -> surface calibration -> secondary -> finish -> facial performance
